title: Zero resampling noise sensitivity
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f$ be any function from length-$n$ inputs over $\Omega$ to signs. The product resampling noise sensitivity of $f$ at resampling rate zero is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$f$ maps length-$n$ inputs over $\Omega$ to signs
